lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows; the central row features the largest spot diameters with relatively uniform spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots, creating a recurring rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A strong horizontal ridge feature is visible, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light superior edge to a shadowed inferior edge, extending from the gill region posteriorly.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of small, discrete high-luminance spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation or notch on the posterior-superior margin of the first dorsal fin; additional small nicks are present along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills displays a transition to a much higher density of significantly smaller, pin-point high-luminance spots.
